Name: Malone and Gunther Portraits
Author: lllllttt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This MOD is a portrait beautification of Marlon and Gunther in Stardew Valley Story.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Replace the original portrait files in the corresponding character expansion mod with these beautified portraits. [b]Make sure the filenames are exactly the same.[/b][/*]
[*]Download[color=#ffffff] [b]Portraiture[/b] an[/color]d create a new folder in the [b][color=#ffffff]Portraits[/color][/b] folder of the mod to place the portrait of the character.[/*]
[/list][b]Choose one suitable option from the above.[/b]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Describe the core features of your mod[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]-[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]-[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Recommended to use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Make Marlon Real[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7102]Make Gunther Real[/url] character expansion mods for the full experience.[/color]
